title: XREPLAY-1 PROBE: qwen3.8-27b -> gpt-5.6-sol mid-session switch with strict_responses_input=false on BOTH rows, so the REPLAY-1 send-time projection is OFF and foreign qwen reasoning items (content+id) ride VERBATIM into the sol /v1/responses request. Open seam: does the non-strict upstream ACCEPT (200) or REJECT (400) the foreign reasoning.content/id? The verdict is the FINDING — 200 and 400 both PASS; any other outcome (no verdict captured, retry storm, no reasoning to replay) FAILs as a probe defect.

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): at least one pre-switch qwen request carried a reasoning INPUT item — real qwen reasoning was emitted, stored, and replayed. If no qwen request ever carried one (model did not emit reasoning), this FAILs and the probe is meaningless. Needle specificity: 'type':'reasoning' appears only on reasoning ITEMS, never on the top-level 'reasoning' request param (which has no type key) or on message items.

VERBATIM REPLAY (1/3): the post-switch sol request carries a reasoning INPUT item — foreign qwen reasoning crossed the switch. The REPLAY-1 projection was OFF (case config strict_responses_input=false on the sol row), so this item is the probe payload.

VERBATIM REPLAY (2/3): the reasoning item's content array is present (vLLM-shim 'reasoning_text' part) — the exact field the strict OpenAI/Azure schema forbids on input (content maxItems:0). Combined with assert (4) pinning exactly ONE sol request, all three needles necessarily hit in that same file, which is what pins 'the item carries content' structurally.

VERBATIM REPLAY (3/3): the reasoning item carries its prior-response id (rs_* prefix — reasoning-item specific in the Responses API) — the exact field Azure/store=false rejects as 'not found: items are not persisted when store is false'. See (2/3) note on the same-file argument.

NO RETRY STORM: exactly one post-switch sol request — the probe fired once and the client did not re-send the same payload (COMP-3 deterministic-error fail-fast class). 0 = the probe never fired; >=2 = same-payload retry storm. This count also makes the three VERBATIM REPLAY greps same-file pins.

ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE (the finding): the post-switch sol request reached a terminal upstream verdict. 200 = upstream ACCEPTED foreign reasoning.content/id (XREPLAY-1 = GREEN-BY-VERIFICATION, zero code); 400 = upstream REJECTED it (XREPLAY-1 = REJECTION-CONFIRMED — the intended finding; the rejecting upstream + param are recorded in the detail). Deliberately NOT pinned to either outcome: both PASS, and the case must survive a 400 so the wire evidence is not masked. Any other status (no verdict / transient / auth) = the probe did not reach a finding -> FAIL, re-run.

XREPLAY-1 VERDICT RECORD: last-captured wire response status line, verbatim (machine-readable finding; recon op — always records, never fails). The authoritative verdict is the resp_status assert above (n-paired to the sol request); this line is the raw resp-capture record.
